_comment: CRON-COMPLETIONIST-68: Jue Ming Valley (决明谷 / 绝命谷) — Valley of Decisive Brightness / Valley of Certain Death. CANON: per Baidu Baike 仙逆编年史 and 知乎专栏 仙逆详细完整剧情, Wang Lin's physical body was destroyed at 决明谷 (Jue Ming Valley) after Teng Huayuan destroyed the Wang family; Situ Nan saved Wang Lin's divine sense by storing it in the 天逆珠 (Heaven-Reversing Bead) and entering the 域外战场 (Extraterrestrial Battlefield). The valley is a staging ground where cultivators gather tokens to enter the Extraterrestrial Battlefield; many kill each other here for tokens (决明谷修士：不计其数). WorldLaws registers jue_ming_valley with space/seal/soul affinities, space-stability 0.3 (unstable — teleportation may shunt into void), Core Formation ceiling, COSMIC_RIFT origin. CLIMATE: cold, low downfall (death-mist not heavy rain), dark purple-gray sky/fog (death-law ambiance), corrupted purple-tinted water. SPAWNERS: bats (cave ambient), spiders/skeletons/zombies (fallen cultivators and predators). FEATURES: foundation_root_vine (VegetalDecoration step 9), demon_corpse_mushroom (UndergroundDecoration step 7), spirit_vein_quartz_ore (UndergroundOres step 6) — per SuzakuFeatureIndex.BIOME_FEATURES. CARVERS: standard cave openings (valley has cave networks leading to depths/abyss). Prime Directive: the valley exists objectively as a canon death-zone; the bead's location is the Foreign Battleground (域外战场), NOT this valley — do not place the bead here. The depths (_depths) and abyss (_abyss) biomes are MOD-ORIGINAL extrapolations of layered cave systems beneath the valley (novel does not explicitly describe layered depths).
